# KhanList – AI News Briefing

820+ Sources, Zero Noise

Free · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Share

iPhone, iPad

Your daily briefing, finishable. The Edge: progress ring, streaks, audio, and a home screen widget. 220+ sources, zero noise. KhanList cuts through the noise. Powered by AI, it pulls from 220+ trusted sources, clusters stories by topic, and delivers The Edge — a finishable daily intelligence briefing — so you stay informed without doomscrolling. THE EDGE — A BRIEFING YOU CAN FINISH Most news apps are bottomless. The Edge is the opposite: every morning you get one finishable edition — the day's essential stories, reviewed one by one until your progress ring closes. Complete the Edge, keep your streak, and get on with your day. No infinite scroll. No FOMO. Done in minutes. YOUR NEWS, ON YOUR HOME SCREEN The KhanList widget puts the Edge on your home screen — rotating headlines and your completion ring at a glance, without opening the app. ASK THE NEWS ANYTHING Have a question about a story? Ask it. KhanList answers from the actual source articles, with numbered citations you can tap to verify. If the sources don't support an answer, it says so. SEE EVERY ANGLE Every story shows its receipts: how many outlets covered it, where they sit on the bias spectrum, and what perspectives may be missing. Blindspot alerts flag stories one side of the media is ignoring. LISTEN INSTEAD Tap Listen and the Edge is read to you in a natural voice — your personalized briefing, hands-free on your commute, at the gym, or over coffee. KEY FEATURES • The Edge — A finishable daily briefing with a progress ring, streaks, and a completion celebration • Home Screen Widget — Headlines and your Edge ring, always a glance away • Ask a Story — Grounded Q&A with tappable citations from real coverage • Bias Receipts & Blindspots — Source diversity and coverage gaps on every story • Audio Edge — Your briefing read aloud in a natural voice • The Wire — When you want more, an adaptive feed across all your topics • Personalized Topics — Politics, AI, finance, climate, sports — you decide • Breaking News Alerts — Instant, opt-in notifications that respect your attention • Reading DNA — Your reading habits: top sources, topics, and balance • Bookmarks & Search — Save articles and search across all sources instantly • Dark Mode & Paper Mode — A polished reading experience, day or night • Ad-Free Briefing — The Edge carries zero ads WHO IT'S FOR KhanList is built for professionals, investors, founders, analysts, and anyone who needs to stay informed without wasting time. If you value signal over noise, this is your news app. PRIVACY FIRST We don't sell your data. Period. Your reading habits, preferences, and bookmarks stay private. Full policy at khanlist.com/privacy.html. Download KhanList and get your Edge.

## What’s New

Sharpening the Edge — fixes and polish across the app. • SHARE THE EDGE: Finishing your briefing now shares a designed daily edition card — edition number, top headlines, and your completed ring — that unfurls beautifully in iMessage, WhatsApp, and X. • SMARTER LINKS: Shared story and edition links now open directly in the app when it's installed, and land on a proper web page (with an App Store banner) when it isn't. • TEXT SIZE ON THE EDGE: A new Aa control in the Edge header — set your reading size for cards and the sector overview, just like in articles. • NEWSLETTER, IN-APP: Subscribing from the Wire banner now happens right in the app — no detour to the website. • NOTIFICATION CLARITY: The preferences screen now explains exactly what All, Breaking, Digest, and Off deliver. • STREAK FIX: Completion streaks now follow your device's clock, and the completion celebration fires reliably every time you finish. Plus: the classic K app icon returns, social links in Settings, and more reliable share sheets.
